cohort: 73 women with MSAF and 73 women with clear amniotic fluid, singleton pregnancies, delivering between 37 and 42 weeks gestation, at a single hospital in Khairpur, Pakistan.
finding: Meconium-stained amniotic fluid was associated with increased risk of several poor neonatal outcomes, including meconium aspiration syndrome, hypoxia-induced encephalopathy, neonatal sepsis, and respiratory distress.
